notes.title: Developer Broadcast
notes.notes:
[p]Step into the ring with me in [b]Shuruka Boxing[/b], the intense, fast-paced fighting game where reflexes and strategy go head-to-head. Watch as I throw combos, dodge deadly counters, and aim for the KO against some fierce opponents. Whether you’re a fighting game fan or just love high-stakes action, this stream’s for you![/p][p]👊 Arcade-style combat
🧠 Mind games and counterplay
🔥 Real-time brawls with cinematic flair
🎮 Come hang out, ask questions, or challenge me if you dare![/p][p]Hit that follow button and join the chaos 💥[/p]
